scripts.generate-api: dotnet build apps/orchestrator && npx --yes @openapitools/openapi-generator-cli generate && sed -i "s/import { RadioPluginUpdateRequest } from ['\"]@contracts['\"];/import { RadioPluginDto, RadioPluginCreateRequest, RadioPluginUpdateRequest } from '@contracts';/" apps/orchestrator/ClientApp/src/app/generated/api/radioPlugins.service.ts && sed -i '/@contracts/d' apps/orchestrator/ClientApp/src/app/generated/model/models.ts && sed -i '/spotifyRecentContextDto/d' apps/orchestrator/ClientApp/src/app/generated/model/models.ts && sed -i '/spotifyReleaseDto/d' apps/orchestrator/ClientApp/src/app/generated/model/models.ts && sed -i '/upgradeSpotifySourceRequest/d' apps/orchestrator/ClientApp/src/app/generated/model/models.ts && sed -i '/nodeReleaseDto/d' apps/orchestrator/ClientApp/src/app/generated/model/models.ts && sed -i '/nodeUpgradeRequest/d' apps/orchestrator/ClientApp/src/app/generated/model/models.ts && sed -i '/updateSettingsRequest/d' apps/orchestrator/ClientApp/src/app/generated/model/models.ts && sed -i '/volumeProfile/d' apps/orchestrator/ClientApp/src/app/generated/model/models.ts && echo "export type { FullStateDto, GroupDto, RoomDto, SpotifyMetadataDto, SpotifySourceDto, StreamDto, SpotifyEventDto, SpotifyRecentContextDto, SpotifyReleaseDto, UpgradeSpotifySourceRequest, NodeReleaseDto, NodeUpgradeRequest, RadioPluginDto, RadioPluginCreateRequest, RadioPluginUpdateRequest, RadioEventPayload, UpdateSettingsRequest, VolumeProfile } from '@contracts';" >> apps/orchestrator/ClientApp/src/app/generated/model/models.ts
scripts.generate-spotify-node-client: docker run --rm -v "$(pwd):/src" -w /src mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 bash -c 'dotnet tool install --global NSwag.ConsoleCore --version 14.2.0 && /root/.dotnet/tools/nswag openapi2csclient /input:${OPENAPI_SPEC:-https://github.com/slaesh/librespot-server/releases/download/v0.3.0/openapi.json} /output:apps/orchestrator/Services/Generated/SpotifyNodeOpenApiClient.cs /namespace:AudioOrchestrator.Services.Generated /className:SpotifyNodeOpenApiClient /OperationGenerationMode:SingleClientFromOperationId /UseBaseUrl:true /InjectHttpClient:true /GenerateClientInterfaces:true /JsonLibrary:SystemTextJson /GenerateNullableReferenceTypes:true'
